name: Main Dining Sit-Down Eggs Benedict & Smoked Salmon Eggs Royale
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder · Triton's / Disney Magic · Lumiere's / Disney Treasure · 1923
whyItWorks: Poached eggs, Canadian bacon (or smoked salmon), and toasted white English muffins are a 9.5/10 flare meal when ordered without lemon hollandaise.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the poached eggs and Canadian bacon/smoked salmon on a toasted English muffin with hollandaise on the side (or skipped altogether, since hollandaise contains lemon juice and heavy liquid butter).
watchOuts: Lemon juice and emulsified butter in hollandaise sauce (order dry/on side)
